profile.headline: Principal Wireless Software Engineer at TeraWave

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer @ Leo (formerly Project Kuiper)
positions.description:
* Led HMAC software development for MAC software team, from initial software bringup to on orbit validation of advanced MAC features.
* Payload software bringup for production.
* Led end to end integration and testing of PAAs for Protoflight.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coyote Rapid Development Programs
* Software Lead for all Coyote Counter-UAS programs, leading multiple teams. Provided technical direction and common software design across programs.
* Developed mission and safety critical embedded software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
IBM Copy Services Manager (CSM)
• Implemented features in using Java, InstallAnywhere, and shell scripts.
• Develop and maintain features for managing CSM such as user management, email alerting, providing authentication services to IBM storage product, etc.
• Developed standalone installer to separate CSM from the existing Tivoli Productivity Center (TPC) product and worked to remove dependencies CSM had on TPC.

SONAS/v7000:
• Implemented features in Linux using C, Expect, Perl, Python and shell scripts.
• Transitioned to lead for Installation/Upgrade component.
• Developed system to automatically detect and appropriately install new servers in SONAS cluster.
• Took initiative to design and develop tool to quickly cleanup and reinstall SONAS and v7000 Unified systems for development and test reducing machine downtime from 2 days to 2 hours.
• Worked with customers on SONAS setup and configuration.

Information Archive:
• Developed 3 hour automated manufacturing process to completely configure Information Archive hardware in rack including: ethernet switches, SAN switches, DASD disk controllers xSeries servers and OS installation.
• Developed hardware health check for support teams to evaluate hardware configuration, firmware levels, ethernet cabling and fibre cabling within appliance.

DR550:
• Created pre-configured AIX server images for DR550 install.
• Developed new upgrade process using AIX’s fileset management, improving upgrade automation and decreasing upgrade time.

patents.title: Comprehensively Testing Functionality of a Computer Program Code Change
patents.description: A computer identifies one or more program functions within program code of a computer program affected by a program code change. The computer identifies program function calls made by the one or more program functions to other program functions. The computer adds the one or more program functions and program function calls to a program code database. The computer generates a mapping of relationships between the program functions of the program code. The computer selects one or more test scripts based on the mapping of relationships.

patents.title: Intelligent rolling upgrade for data storage systems
